page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core CPU performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25% in stress-ng and Geekbench tests, while single-threaded gzip compression is poor, ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Memory bandwidth, database operations, and static web serving throughput also consistently rank in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for multi-threaded workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as multi-threaded database operations, static web serving, and moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models, where parallel processing can offset the lower single-core clock speed.
